rag_usage_hints: For local/unit Robolectric Hilt tests, use @HiltAndroidTest plus @get:Rule val hiltRule = HiltAndroidRule(this), then call hiltRule.inject().
Use @UninstallModules for per-test replacement; prefer @TestInstallIn for shared test modules.
Use @BindValue for simple fake instance replacement directly from a test field.

Do not use FragmentScenario.launchFragmentInContainer with an @AndroidEntryPoint Fragment (host is not a Hilt Activity). Attach via an existing @AndroidEntryPoint Activity in the same module (Robolectric.buildActivity + FragmentTransaction.commitNow).
Remember annotation processing setup: kaptTest/kspTest with com.google.dagger:hilt-android-compiler:2.49.
